name: daily-standup
description: Summarize yesterday's git commits and today's plan into a standup note for the active project.
author: jarvis-os

steps.title: Inspect the git log for the last 24 hours and list changed files
Group the changes into themes and note anything unfinished
Write the standup note: done / doing / blockers

validation: the note lists real commits from the git log, nothing invented
failure_recovery: if git history is unavailable, say so and summarize the current diff instead
